title: Revised hydrogeologic framework of the Floridan aquifer system in the northern coastal area of Georgia and adjacent parts of South Carolina
citation: Williams, L.J., and Gill, H.E., 2010, Revised hydrogeologic framework of the Floridan aquifer system in the northern coastal area of Georgia and adjacent parts of South Carolina: U.S. Geological Survey Scientific Investigations Report SIR-2010-5158, map scale 1:300,000.
notes:
Pages 1-28: front matter, abstract, introduction, geologic setting, structure, table 1 (well construction) and table 2 (current-meter tests). Observations limited to the South Carolina wells of table 1 (Georgia wells skipped) and the SC current-meter test (BFT-315). Figure 3/4 correlation charts are garbled by layout and not read. Location values are the table's latitude/longitude (NAD 83) as printed. References are in a later packet.
Pages 29-60: Georgia test sites (Richmond Hill, Berwick, Rincon, Savannah No. 5, Pineora, Hunter Army Airfield), Piper diagrams, figure 19 chart, cross sections, Upper Floridan maps. Geophysical log figures, Piper diagrams and contour maps are not readable as text and were skipped. Georgia well-log zone depths were not recorded as observations; site transmissivities and confining-unit properties recorded as groundwater values. Table 3 (lower Brunswick wells, Chatham County, GA) not itemized beyond the Pooler value in text. Cedar Keys Formation is called lower Eocene on p. 52 but Paleocene on p. 17 (packet 1).
Pages 61-89: Upper Floridan transmissivity and storage text, table 4 (pp. 62-66; only the South Carolina rows on pp. 64-66 recorded, one groundwater entry per well; Georgia rows skipped), middle confining unit, Lower Floridan aquifer, aquifer interconnection (Georgia well clusters, table 5, not recorded), summary, selected references (pp. 83-86; SC-relevant and regional Floridan references recorded, general and Georgia-only references skipped), start of appendix A (pp. 87-89, Georgia wells only, not recorded; appendix continues in the next packet). Contour maps (figs. 30-35) and hydrographs (figs. 36-40) skipped. Table 4 values are paired by row position and flagged inferred; wrapped reference names in table 4 were completed from the next line. Page 82 says 'Chatham and Bryan Counties, SC' for Georgia counties (source error, not recorded).
